name: Bremen
summary: At least eight alternating horizontal red and white stripes, with a chequered border at the hoist. Nicknamed the 'Speckflagge' (bacon flag), it reflects Bremen's history as a Hanseatic city.
origin: Red and white were the colours of the Hanseatic League. The striped flag was used by Bremen's ships for centuries and was formally adopted in 1891.

symbols.name: Chequered hoist
symbols.description: Red and white squares along the hoist.

facts: Its nickname 'Speckflagge' comes from its resemblance to streaky bacon.
The state flag adds the Bremen key.
clues: Red and white stripes with a chequered border at the hoist.
The flag of Germany's smallest state, a Hanseatic city.
